name: Helion Manufacturing Radiation Exposure Suit
description:
A lead-composite layered suit designed for work in environments with elevated ionizing radiation. The suit incorporates dosimetry sensors at twelve body points that provide real-time exposure tracking. When cumulative dose approaches safe limits, the suit's collar-mounted indicator changes from green to amber to red.

Used in reactor maintenance, medical imaging equipment servicing, and the cleanup of sites where radioactive materials have been improperly stored or dumped — which in Meridian 88's lower tiers happens more often than any authority acknowledges.
functionality: Ionizing radiation shielding, real-time dose tracking, exposure limit warnings
what_it_says: You work near things that damage your DNA and this suit is the only reason your cells are still copying correctly.
story_hooks: A Radiation Exposure Suit's dosimetry logs show a worker was exposed to a radiation source that doesn't match anything at their assigned work site — something radioactive was there that wasn't supposed to be.
